content: There are many mistakes appearing in my credit report without my understanding. For example, an old utility bill from 2015 is listed as unpaid, but I have proof of payment.

There is an account reporting on my credit report from Wells Fargo which is saying the balance is coming from Bank of America from January 2012. I never signed a joint lease with anyone, and this account does not belong to me.

I received a final notice of pre-legal notification from a company called XXXX XXXX XXXX regarding a collection for an XXXX credit account. I never opened this account. They allege a charge off date of 2017. I owe them nothing.
A debt collector called me at work multiple times per day despite my request to stop. They threatened to contact my employer and file a lawsuit within 48 hours if I do not pay immediately.

My mortgage servicing was transferred to LoanCare LLC. I sent my first payment through Bill Pay but discovered it had not been applied. My second payment has not been posted either. I have talked to multiple people with no resolution.
I was denied a mortgage loan due to an error on my application. Wells Fargo claimed my debt-to-income ratio was too high, but they included a debt that has been paid off for over a year.
I was billed twice on my credit card for the same purchase. When I called Chase to dispute the charge, the representative was rude and refused to reverse it. I have been a customer for 15 years.

I have been overdrawn at TCF bank for a day and a half. They have charged me a total of 380 dollars in fees. Most of these fees are for transactions that were pending before I became overdrawn. I called to complain and they only credited back 120 dollars.

I received a call from Lincoln Tech Receivable Division about my student loan payments. I was told to start paying 30 dollars every two weeks. I have never missed a payment but noticed the loan was charged off on my credit. When I called to ask why, they gave me conflicting answers about the balance.

I tried accessing my Coinbase account and they locked it, claiming I logged in from a prohibited country. I have provided ID and proof of address multiple times. I am afraid they may seize my funds and I have already lost a lot of money.

I applied for a Lending Club loan. They advertised a start-to-finish process of seven days. After 8 days, no documents had been reviewed. Customer service told me the process actually takes up to 30 days. This constitutes bait and switch.

I opened a joint installment account for a used car in 2013. The terms were for 84 months. The vehicle was repossessed in 2015 due to missed payments. The past due amount reported is much higher than what was owed. I want the incorrect dates removed from my report.
